commands.summary: Read C# Console service state and Unity Editor/play-mode state.
positiveIntents: check whether the Unity Editor is ready
检查 Unity 编辑器是否就绪
negativeIntents: inspect only the play-mode transition state
commands.verification: Require all result fields and cross-check play-mode fields with editor/playmode.status.

commands.summary: Read Unity play-mode and play-mode transition state only.
positiveIntents: check whether Unity is entering or leaving play mode
检查 Unity 是否正在切换播放模式
negativeIntents: check general Editor or service readiness
commands.verification: Require a coherent play-mode state and compare shared fields with editor/status.

commands.summary: Request entry into play mode; completion is asynchronous.
positiveIntents: enter Unity play mode
进入 Unity 播放模式
negativeIntents: check whether Unity is already in play mode
commands.verification: Poll editor/playmode.status until isPlaying is true and isCompiling is false.

commands.summary: Request exit from play mode; completion is asynchronous.
positiveIntents: exit Unity play mode
退出 Unity 播放模式
negativeIntents: check current play-mode state
commands.verification: Poll editor/playmode.status until isPlaying and isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode are false.

commands.blockedReason: non-interactive menu execution can open modal dialogs and is intentionally disabled
commands.summary: Blocked in non-interactive mode because opening menu items can display modal dialogs.
positiveIntents: attempt to invoke a Unity menu item
尝试调用 Unity 菜单项
negativeIntents: run a supported non-interactive editor command
commands.verification: Require a validation error that states the command is blocked.

commands.blockedReason: non-interactive Editor window creation can open modal dialogs and is intentionally disabled
commands.summary: Blocked in non-interactive mode because opening Editor windows can display modal dialogs.
positiveIntents: attempt to open a Unity Editor window
尝试打开 Unity 编辑器窗口
negativeIntents: inspect an existing scene or GameObject
commands.verification: Require a validation error that states the command is blocked.

commands.summary: Clear entries from the Unity Editor Console when the Unity version exposes that operation.
positiveIntents: clear the Unity Editor Console
清空 Unity 编辑器控制台
negativeIntents: read or filter Unity console messages
commands.verification: Require success only when Console clearing is available; otherwise require a validation error.

commands.summary: Write a unique searchable marker to the Editor log and return its log location.
positiveIntents: mark the Unity log before an operation
在操作前为 Unity 日志写入标记
negativeIntents: clear or read existing console messages
commands.verification: Require a nonempty id and find markerText containing that id in the returned logPath.

commands.summary: Read a bounded recent or post-marker Unity Editor log window.

args.name: afterMarkerId
args.patternError: must be empty or a 32-character hexadecimal editor/console.mark id

positiveIntents: read recent or post-operation Unity Editor diagnostics
读取最近或某次操作之后的 Unity 编辑器诊断
negativeIntents: clear or modify the Unity Console
read arbitrary files or stream the complete Editor log
commands.verification: For causal checks, mark first and pass its id; require marker content to be absent and treat truncated=true as incomplete evidence.

commands.summary: Find up to 500 GameObjects in loaded scenes and DontDestroyOnLoad by name, tag, and/or component type.
positiveIntents: find GameObjects with a given name, tag, or component
按名称、标签或组件查找游戏对象
negativeIntents: return the complete active-scene hierarchy tree
commands.verification: Require every returned object to satisfy all supplied filters and never return more than 500 entries.

commands.summary: Create an empty GameObject or Unity primitive, optionally under a hierarchy parent.
positiveIntents: create an empty GameObject or primitive
创建空游戏对象或基础几何体
negativeIntents: instantiate an existing prefab asset
commands.verification: Read back gameobject/get by result instanceId and require matching name and path.

commands.summary: Destroy one scene GameObject selected by hierarchy path or instance ID.
positiveIntents: delete a GameObject from a loaded scene
从已加载场景删除游戏对象
negativeIntents: delete an asset or a child inside a prefab asset
commands.verification: Require destroyed to be true and require gameobject/get for the result instanceId to report not found.

commands.summary: Read one scene GameObject's identity, state, transform summary, and component summary.
positiveIntents: inspect one GameObject and its components
查看单个游戏对象及其组件摘要
negativeIntents: read serialized fields of one specific component
commands.verification: Require the returned selector to identify the requested object and compare transform fields with transform/get.

commands.summary: Change one scene GameObject's name, tag, layer, active state, and/or static flag.
positiveIntents: rename or change basic properties of a GameObject
修改游戏对象名称、标签、层或激活状态
negativeIntents: change transform values or serialized component fields
commands.verification: Read back gameobject/get and require each requested property to match.

commands.summary: Reparent one scene GameObject or move it to a scene root.
positiveIntents: reparent a GameObject or move it to the scene root
重新设置游戏对象父级或移到场景根节点
negativeIntents: set a parent inside a prefab asset
commands.verification: Read back gameobject/get and require its path and preserved/local transform policy to match.

commands.summary: Duplicate one scene GameObject under the same parent.
positiveIntents: duplicate a GameObject in the current scene
复制当前场景中的游戏对象
negativeIntents: copy an asset file or instantiate a prefab
commands.verification: Require a new instanceId and read back an object with the expected name, parent, transform, and components.

commands.summary: Add one resolved Component type to a scene GameObject.
positiveIntents: add a component to a scene GameObject
给场景游戏对象添加组件
negativeIntents: add a component directly inside a prefab asset
commands.verification: Read back component/get and require the returned componentInstanceId and type.

commands.summary: Remove one indexed Component type from a scene GameObject.
positiveIntents: remove a component from a scene GameObject
从场景游戏对象移除组件
negativeIntents: remove a component directly from a prefab asset
commands.verification: Require removed to be true and read back one fewer component of the requested type.

commands.summary: Read up to 200 visible serialized properties from one indexed Component on a scene GameObject.
positiveIntents: inspect serialized fields of one component
查看单个组件的序列化字段
negativeIntents: list only the component types attached to a GameObject
commands.verification: Require matching type and component index and no more than 200 property entries.

commands.summary: Set supported visible serialized properties on one indexed Component of a scene GameObject.
positiveIntents: change serialized fields on a component
修改组件的序列化字段
negativeIntents: change GameObject identity or transform properties
commands.verification: Require modifiedFields to equal requested field names and read back each value with component/get.

commands.summary: Read local and world transform values for one scene GameObject.
positiveIntents: read exact local and world transform values
读取精确的本地与世界变换值
negativeIntents: inspect general GameObject state and component summaries
commands.verification: Compare equivalent transform fields with gameobject/get for the same instanceId.

commands.summary: Set position and Euler rotation in local or world space and/or set local scale.
positiveIntents: move, rotate, or scale a scene GameObject
移动、旋转或缩放场景游戏对象
negativeIntents: change RectTransform or another component serialized field
commands.verification: Read back transform/get and compare requested vectors with floating-point tolerance in the requested space.

commands.summary: Create a Material asset under Assets using a named shader, with Standard-to-URP-Lit fallback.
positiveIntents: create a new material asset
创建新的材质资源
negativeIntents: assign an existing material to a Renderer
commands.verification: Read back material/get by result assetPath and require the resolved shaderName.

commands.summary: Read one Material asset or the first shared Material on a GameObject's Renderer.
positiveIntents: inspect a material shader and its properties
查看材质着色器及其属性
negativeIntents: inspect all serialized fields of a Renderer component
commands.verification: Require a nonempty shaderName and unique property names from the selected Material.

commands.summary: Assign a Material asset to one shared-material slot on a Renderer attached directly to a scene GameObject.
positiveIntents: assign a material to a Renderer slot
把材质分配给渲染器槽位
negativeIntents: create or edit the material asset itself
commands.verification: Read back the target Renderer shared-material slot and require the requested materialPath.

commands.summary: Save one scene GameObject as a Prefab asset under Assets.
positiveIntents: create a prefab asset from a scene GameObject
从场景游戏对象创建预制体资源
negativeIntents: instantiate an existing prefab into a scene
commands.verification: Read back prefab/asset_get at the result assetPath and require the expected root name.

commands.summary: Instantiate one Prefab asset into the active scene, optionally under a parent and at a world position.
positiveIntents: instantiate a prefab in the active scene
在活动场景实例化预制体
negativeIntents: create a new prefab asset from a scene object
commands.verification: Read back gameobject/get by result instanceId and require the requested parent and world position.

commands.summary: Unpack the outermost or complete Prefab relationship for one scene Prefab instance.
positiveIntents: unpack a prefab instance in the scene
解包场景中的预制体实例
negativeIntents: delete or edit the prefab asset file
commands.verification: Require unpacked to be true and verify that the scene object no longer has the requested Prefab relationship.

commands.summary: Read up to 5000 hierarchy nodes from one Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: inspect the hierarchy stored inside a prefab asset
查看预制体资源内部层级
negativeIntents: inspect the active scene hierarchy
commands.verification: Require the returned root to match asset_get for the same asset and respect the requested depth.

commands.summary: Read one GameObject stored inside a Prefab asset, using an empty relative path for its root.
positiveIntents: inspect one object stored inside a prefab asset
查看预制体资源中的单个对象
negativeIntents: inspect a prefab instance in a loaded scene
commands.verification: Require assetPath and canonical relative gameObjectPath to round-trip through prefab/asset_hierarchy.

commands.summary: Read up to 200 visible serialized properties from one indexed Component stored in a Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: inspect component fields inside a prefab asset
查看预制体资源内组件字段
negativeIntents: inspect a component on a loaded scene object
commands.verification: Require the selected type and index and no more than 200 property entries.

commands.summary: Set supported visible serialized properties on one indexed Component stored in a Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: modify serialized component fields directly in a prefab asset
直接修改预制体资源中的组件字段
negativeIntents: modify a component on a loaded scene object
commands.verification: Require modifiedFields to equal requested field names and read back each value after reloading the Prefab asset.

commands.summary: Add one resolved Component type directly to a GameObject stored in a Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: add a component directly to a prefab asset
直接给预制体资源添加组件
negativeIntents: add a component to a loaded scene instance
commands.verification: Reload the Prefab asset and require a component of the returned type at gameObjectPath.

commands.summary: Remove one indexed Component directly from a GameObject stored in a Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: remove a component directly from a prefab asset
直接从预制体资源移除组件
negativeIntents: remove a component from a loaded scene instance
commands.verification: Require removed to be true and read back one fewer matching component after reloading the Prefab asset.

commands.summary: Change basic properties of one GameObject stored directly in a Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: rename or change basic properties inside a prefab asset
修改预制体资源内对象的基础属性
negativeIntents: modify a prefab instance in a loaded scene
commands.verification: Reload prefab/asset_get and require every requested property to match.

commands.summary: Add an empty child GameObject directly under a parent stored in a Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: add a child object directly inside a prefab asset
直接在预制体资源中添加子对象
negativeIntents: add a child to a loaded scene object
commands.verification: Reload prefab/asset_get at result gameObjectPath and require the returned name.

commands.summary: Remove a non-root child GameObject directly from a Prefab asset.
positiveIntents: remove a child object directly from a prefab asset
直接从预制体资源删除子对象
negativeIntents: destroy a loaded scene GameObject or remove the prefab root
commands.verification: Require removed to be true and require prefab/asset_get at the removed path to report not found after reload.

commands.summary: List all Scene assets in the project and report the active Scene path.
positiveIntents: list scene assets available in the Unity project
列出 Unity 项目中的场景资源
negativeIntents: list only currently loaded scenes or inspect scene contents
commands.verification: Require sorted unique Scene asset paths and a valid or empty activeScenePath.

commands.summary: Open one Scene asset in single or additive mode; single mode refuses unsaved loaded Scenes.
positiveIntents: open a Unity scene asset
打开 Unity 场景资源
negativeIntents: inspect the hierarchy of the already active scene
commands.verification: Require openedPath to match scenePath and the loaded-scene set to reflect the requested mode.

commands.summary: Save the active Scene in place or to a destination path, optionally as a copy.
positiveIntents: save the active Unity scene
保存当前活动 Unity 场景
negativeIntents: save a different loaded scene selected by path
commands.verification: Require saved to be true, the destination Scene asset to exist, and the active Scene to be clean unless saved as a copy.

commands.summary: Read the current Unity Editor selection and its active object.
positiveIntents: inspect the current Unity Editor selection
查看 Unity 编辑器当前选择
negativeIntents: find objects by name, tag, or component
commands.verification: Require activeInstanceId to be zero or a member of the returned object IDs.

commands.summary: Set or clear the Unity Editor selection from object instance IDs and asset paths; invalid entries are ignored.
positiveIntents: select objects or assets in the Unity Editor
在 Unity 编辑器中选择对象或资源
negativeIntents: find an object by hierarchy path or name
commands.verification: Read back project/selection.get and require the accepted distinct instance IDs to match.

commands.summary: List sorted project asset paths matching a Unity AssetDatabase filter and optional search folders.
positiveIntents: find project assets by Unity type or name filter
按 Unity 类型或名称筛选项目资源
negativeIntents: move, copy, import, or delete an asset
commands.verification: Require sorted unique paths whose AssetDatabase search matches the supplied filter and folders.

commands.summary: Import one asset path, optionally synchronously, while guarding loaded Scenes and script-triggered domain reloads.
positiveIntents: import a newly written asset into Unity
把新写入的资源导入 Unity
negativeIntents: force-update an already imported asset
commands.verification: Require imported and exists to be true and read back the path with project/asset.list.

commands.summary: Force-update one imported asset path, optionally synchronously, with Scene and domain-reload guards.
positiveIntents: force Unity to reimport an existing asset
强制 Unity 重新导入已有资源
negativeIntents: import a new asset for the first time
commands.verification: Require imported and exists to be true and require the target path to remain resolvable.

commands.summary: Move or rename one Unity asset or folder, creating missing destination parent folders.
positiveIntents: move or rename a Unity asset
移动或重命名 Unity 资源
negativeIntents: copy an asset while retaining the source
commands.verification: Require the old path to be absent and the new path to resolve after the operation.

commands.summary: Copy one Unity asset or folder to a new path, creating missing destination parent folders.
positiveIntents: copy a Unity asset to another path
复制 Unity 资源到新路径
negativeIntents: move or rename an asset
commands.verification: Require both paths to resolve and their asset GUIDs to differ.

commands.summary: Delete one or more Unity assets or folders and report partial failures.
positiveIntents: delete Unity assets or folders
删除 Unity 资源或文件夹
negativeIntents: destroy a GameObject in a loaded scene
commands.verification: Count completion only when failedPaths is empty and every deletedPath no longer resolves.

commands.summary: Create a Unity AssetDatabase folder recursively, or return the existing folder's GUID.
positiveIntents: create a folder in the Unity Assets tree
在 Unity Assets 中创建文件夹
negativeIntents: create an operating-system folder outside the Unity project
commands.verification: Require a nonempty guid and require the returned folderPath to be a valid AssetDatabase folder.

commands.summary: Read up to 5000 hierarchy nodes from the active Scene plus DontDestroyOnLoad roots.
positiveIntents: inspect the active scene hierarchy
查看活动场景层级
negativeIntents: list Scene assets in the project or inspect a prefab asset
commands.verification: Require scenePath to match the active Scene and every returned branch to respect the requested depth.

commands.summary: Render the last active Scene View camera to a PNG file.
positiveIntents: capture the current Unity Scene View
截取当前 Unity 场景视图
negativeIntents: capture the Game View or a runtime frame
commands.verification: Require the PNG file to exist before completion and require its dimensions to match the result.

commands.summary: Render a scene camera in edit mode or schedule a Game View screenshot for end-of-frame in play mode.
positiveIntents: capture the Unity Game View or gameplay frame
截取 Unity 游戏视图或运行画面
negativeIntents: capture the Scene View editor camera
commands.verification: Wait for the PNG file to exist, then require its dimensions to match the result.

commands.summary: Start Unity Profiler recording, optionally enabling deep profiling and binary logging.
positiveIntents: start recording Unity Profiler data
开始记录 Unity Profiler 数据
negativeIntents: inspect current profiler state without changing it
commands.verification: Read profiler/status and require enabled, deepProfiling, and logFile to match the request.

commands.summary: Stop Unity Profiler recording and disable binary logging.
positiveIntents: stop recording Unity Profiler data
停止记录 Unity Profiler 数据
negativeIntents: save already recorded profiler data to a file
commands.verification: Require stopped to be true and profiler/status enabled to be false.

commands.summary: Read Unity Profiler enabled, deep-profiling, log-file, and frame-count state.
positiveIntents: check whether the Unity Profiler is recording
检查 Unity Profiler 是否正在记录
negativeIntents: check general Unity Editor readiness
commands.verification: Require frameCount to be nonnegative and state to round-trip with profiler/start and profiler/stop.

commands.summary: Save recorded Unity Profiler data to a raw profile file when the Unity version supports it.
positiveIntents: save captured Unity Profiler data
保存已捕获的 Unity Profiler 数据
negativeIntents: start or stop profiler recording
commands.verification: Require saved to be true and the returned file to exist and be nonempty.

commands.summary: List active named REPL sessions and whether each owns a compiler or executor.
positiveIntents: list active unity-cli REPL sessions
列出活动的 unity-cli REPL 会话
negativeIntents: list Unity scenes or GameObjects
commands.verification: Require unique nonempty session IDs and cross-check each entry with session/inspect.

commands.summary: Inspect one named REPL session supplied through the request session ID or CLI --session.
positiveIntents: inspect a named unity-cli REPL session
查看命名的 unity-cli REPL 会话
negativeIntents: inspect a Unity scene object or C# component
commands.verification: Require missing session IDs to fail; otherwise require exists to equal hasCompiler or hasExecutor.

commands.summary: Reset compiler and executor state for one named REPL session supplied through the request session ID or CLI --session.
positiveIntents: reset a named unity-cli REPL session
重置命名的 unity-cli REPL 会话
negativeIntents: reset the Unity scene or Editor state
commands.verification: Require hasCompilerAfter and hasExecutorAfter to be false and confirm with session/inspect.

commands.summary: List registered built-in and custom command descriptors; descriptors omit defaults, constraints, and result schemas.
positiveIntents: discover registered Unity command descriptors
发现已注册的 Unity 命令描述符
negativeIntents: list scene assets, GameObjects, or reusable snippets
commands.verification: Require unique command IDs, valid descriptor fields, and inclusion of command/list itself.
